description: enviroportal.sk: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by enviroportal.sk. Coverage: the area served by enviroportal.sk. The listing groups 12 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Výroba kovov, strojov, dopravných prostriedkov - podiel zamestnaných v; Zariadenia dopravy a technickej infraštruktúry [Atlas krajiny Slovensk; Železničné križovatky [Atlas krajiny Slovenskej republiky]; Výroba kovov, strojov, dopravných prostriedkov - počet pracovníkov [At. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
